closeDateUpdated.title: Close Date Updated
closeDateUpdated.description: True if the close date was changed in this update.

errorMessage.title: Error Message
errorMessage.description: If success is false, contains the error details. Null when successful. Report this to the user if present.

message.title: Message
message.description: Human-readable summary of what was updated. Example: Updated Champion, Economic Buyer. Scores: Champion (4/5 - strong).

newCloseDate.title: New Close Date
newCloseDate.description: If close date was updated, contains the new date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

newNextStep.title: New Next Step
newNextStep.description: If next step was updated, contains the new next step text.

newOverallScore.title: New Overall Score
newOverallScore.description: The recalculated overall MEDDPICC score (1.0-5.0 average) after the update. Use this to report deal qualification strength.

newStageName.title: New Stage Name
newStageName.description: If stage was updated, contains the new stage name. Example: "Negotiation"

nextStepUpdated.title: Next Step Updated
nextStepUpdated.description: True if the next step was changed in this update.

opportunityJson.title: Opportunity JSON
opportunityJson.description: Full JSON of the updated Opportunity record with all MEDDPICC fields. Use for detailed field inspection if needed.

previousCloseDate.title: Previous Close Date
previousCloseDate.description: If close date was updated, contains the previous date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

previousNextStep.title: Previous Next Step
previousNextStep.description: If next step was updated, contains the previous next step for reference.

previousStageName.title: Previous Stage Name
previousStageName.description: If stage was updated, contains the previous stage name for reference.

stageUpdated.title: Stage Updated
stageUpdated.description: True if the opportunity stage was changed in this update. Use this to inform the user about stage progression.

success.title: Success
success.description: Whether the MEDDPICC update completed successfully. True if fields were updated, false if an error occurred.

updatedFields.title: Updated Fields
updatedFields.description: List of MEDDPICC dimension names that had their text content updated. Example: Champion, Economic Buyer, Identify Pain.

updatedScoresJson.title: Updated Scores JSON
updatedScoresJson.description: JSON map of dimension names to their new numeric scores (1-5). Example: {"Champion": 4, "Economic Buyer": 3}.
